column4: There was a nuance in his tone that suggested he was upset, though he didn't say it outright.
Her behavior was a paradigm of professionalism.
The child's prattle went on for hours without making much sense.
The judge's pronouncement ended the heated debate in the courtroom.
He was a strong proponent of renewable energy solutions.
His prosaic speech failed to inspire the audience.
The lawyer's rebuttal weakened the opposing counsel's case.
The witness recanted her earlier testimony after realizing it was incorrect.
She repudiated the accusations made against her.
The company rescinded the offer after a background check revealed discrepancies.
The politician's rhetoric was filled with persuasive and convincing points.
The auditor scrutinized the financial records for any discrepancies.
The poet used a simile to describe her smile as bright as the sun.
His comment was tangential to the topic being discussed.
She published a treatise on the environmental effects of deforestation.
His verbose explanation made the simple concept difficult to follow.
The old mansion had an eerie aura that made everyone uncomfortable.
His bombastic remarks made it hard for anyone to take him seriously.
Her buoyant personality made her the life of the party.
His callous disregard for others' feelings left everyone shocked.
The cantankerous neighbor complained about everything.
The weather in the mountains is notoriously capricious, changing without warning.
Her caustic remarks stung even though they were meant as a joke.
The convivial atmosphere at the party made everyone feel welcome.
She is very demonstrative, always expressing her emotions clearly and without hesitation.
